conf.comment: Zscaler ZIA Firewall log, syslog-csv (positional, no keys on the wire), direct route. This dataset supplies no field rows (fields: []) for this format: the on-wire key/column names are operator-defined by the NSS Feed Output Format template, not a fixed vendor schema, and the work order's own mnemonic hints are inconsistent (e.g. web CEF notes name 'eurl' in one place, 'ehost'+'b64url' in another for what may be the same token). Per the brief, no field-level ECS rename is attempted here - only structural decode plus event.dataset. Field-level mapping is a gap - see README. This format is riskier than CEF/LEEF/KV: no field names exist on the wire at all, and free-text values (URLs, user agents) can contain the delimiter itself. No positional rename is attempted here.
